testEffect: The exact values three separate calls (`subtotal`, `applyDiscount`, `checkout`) each return are coerced through `Boolean(...)` into one truthy check, discarding what any of them actually computed.
productionEffect: Changing `subtotal`, `applyDiscount`, or `checkout` to return any other truthy number (for example always returning 1) would not fail this test, since only truthiness is checked; it is expected to keep passing under that production mutation.
